recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, joyful portrait of a woman with dark hair blowing across her face, set against a neutral, slightly overexposed background. The composition features a dynamic diagonal tilt of the head and a high-contrast interplay between dark hair and bright skin tones.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal flow of the hair balances the top-left script placement
The wide-spaced title at the top right creates a sense of airy openness
Warm skin tones contrast against the deep black of the hair and clothing
The upward gaze of the subject directs the viewer's eye toward the top-right text
coreInvariants: Wind-blown hair texture with visible fine strands
High-key background to isolate the subject
Asymmetrical composition with significant head tilt

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered but tilted, filling approximately 80% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's bright smile and the silver hoop earring act as central focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the sweep of the hair from left to right, then moves up to the spaced-out title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper corners to allow for typographic breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and peach skin tones provide the primary warmth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep obsidian black in the hair and clothing provides structural contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver/white highlights in the earring and teeth provide sharp points of light.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the background and skin, low value in the hair; saturation is naturalistic but warm.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or neon colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of Spencerian script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: The primary name uses extreme flourishes and interlocking loops
The secondary title uses ultra-wide tracking with minimal weight
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders in the script are elongated into decorative swirls
Sans-serif characters are reduced to thin, uniform strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a dense, ornate script with a sparse, minimalist sans-serif.

preserve: The wide tracking of the top-right text
The flourished nature of the top-left text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ornate, flourished script style of the name.
Provides the clean, geometric skeleton for the wide-spaced title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a woman with long dark hair blowing across her face. Use warm studio lighting and a high-key, off-white background. The subject should be smiling and tilted diagonally. Ensure the top corners are clear of hair for text placement.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a flourished script logo in the top left corner. Add a light-weight, all-caps sans-serif title in the top right with extreme letter spacing (tracking).

verificationChecks: Is the hair texture fine and wind-swept?
Is the script text flourished and interlocking?
Is the sans-serif text spaced widely across the top right?
Is the lighting warm and flattering?

mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital sharpness; maintain a soft, film-like grain
Ensure the script does not obscure the face

avoid: Modern sans-serif fonts with tight tracking

postGenerationChecks: Verify the wide tracking doesn't break word legibility
Ensure the earring has a realistic metallic sheen
Confirm the diagonal composition feels balanced
recipe.reuseFormula: Joyful Portrait + Wind-swept Hair + (Flourished Script [Top Left] + Wide-Spaced Sans [Top Right])
